items.question: Diazepam enhances the action of which inhibitory neurotransmitter?
items.explanation: Benzodiazepines enhance GABA-A receptor activity (increase chloride channel opening frequency).

items.question: Carbamazepine is the drug of choice for?
items.explanation: Carbamazepine is first-line for trigeminal neuralgia and focal seizures; blocks Na+ channels.

items.question: Levetiracetam acts by binding to which synaptic protein?
items.explanation: Levetiracetam binds synaptic vesicle protein SV2A, modulating neurotransmitter release; broad-spectrum.

items.question: Why is flumazenil avoided in mixed overdose with tricyclic antidepressants?
options: Removing benzodiazepine protection may unmask TCA-induced seizures
items.explanation: Benzodiazepines protect against TCA seizures; flumazenil can precipitate them in mixed overdose.

items.question: Inclisiran lowers LDL cholesterol as a?
items.explanation: Inclisiran is an siRNA that silences hepatic PCSK9 synthesis, given twice yearly to lower LDL.

*PharmaCraft Daily - 31 Oct 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (CNS)
Q: Diazepam enhances the action of which inhibitory neurotransmitter?
Ans: GABA
Why: Benzodiazepines enhance GABA-A receptor activity (increase chloride channel opening frequency).

🌍 *FMGE* (CNS)
Q: Carbamazepine is the drug of choice for?
Ans: Trigeminal neuralgia
Why: Carbamazepine is first-line for trigeminal neuralgia and focal seizures; blocks Na+ channels.

🩺 *NEET PG* (CNS)
Q: Levetiracetam acts by binding to which synaptic protein?
Ans: SV2A
Why: Levetiracetam binds synaptic vesicle protein SV2A, modulating neurotransmitter release; broad-spectrum.

🏥 *INI-CET* (CNS)
Q: Why is flumazenil avoided in mixed overdose with tricyclic antidepressants?
Ans: Removing benzodiazepine protection may unmask TCA-induced seizures
Why: Benzodiazepines protect against TCA seizures; flumazenil can precipitate them in mixed overdose.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Paper IV: Recent Advances)
Q: Inclisiran lowers LDL cholesterol as a?
Ans: Small interfering RNA (siRNA) targeting PCSK9
Why: Inclisiran is an siRNA that silences hepatic PCSK9 synthesis, given twice yearly to lower LDL.
